scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of commercial and residential structures, including a large white building with a flat roof and balconies on the left, and a smaller white building with a pitched roof and ornate details on the right. The street is lined with various vehicles, pedestrians, and street furniture such as benches and trash cans. A person wearing a red shirt walks along the sidewalk on the right side of the street, while another individual stands near a bus stop on the left. The sky above is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street vary in height and style, with some featuring balconies and others having more modern designs. The larger building on the left has a flat roof, while the smaller one on the right boasts a pitched roof with decorative elements. The street itself is paved with asphalt and features white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and traffic lanes.
scene_analysis.materials: The facades of the buildings are primarily made of stone, with some featuring smooth surfaces and others displaying intricate carvings and ornate details. The street is paved with asphalt, and there are several streetlights and trash cans scattered throughout the area.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans placed along the sidewalk, providing a place for pedestrians to rest and dispose of waste. A few bicycles are parked near the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are no visible plants or trees in the immediate vicinity, although there may be some distant vegetation beyond the buildings.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including directional signs and informational posters. Some of the signs are illegible, but others display clear messages about traffic rules and regulations.
